description:
Mullery O’Gara are delighted to present to the market 49 Kenilworth Square, an exceptional period residence where timeless architectural character meets outstanding contemporary craftsmanship. One of a pair of handsome brick-fronted semi-detached homes, this impressive property has been meticulously restored and thoughtfully extended to create a truly turnkey home of exceptional quality. Set behind an original cut-stone boundary wall, one with the best setting of all, with a spectacular view looking right down the full length of Kenilworth Square West and boasting a south-facing rear garden extends to approx 28m which is beautifully landscaped with mature trees and generous lawn. Every aspect of the house has been considered with impeccable standards and finishes throughout. 

Sympathetically restored and thoughtfully extended in recent years under the supervision of an architect and by the current owners. The property has been meticulously upgraded to the highest of standards and with no expense spared, some of the recent upgrades include a SieMatic designed kitchen with Gaggenau appliances, hand turned and painted curtain rails, curtains of linen and silk,
light fittings by Porto Romano of Chelsea and a Lutron lighting system. The result is a truly exceptional home beautifully balanced between period elegance and modern architectural design. Exceptionally well-proportioned throughout, the accommodation is flooded with natural light and retains a wealth of original features and is complemented by stylish contemporary interiors.

Granite steps lead to the principal hallway with Georgian over door fan window, ceiling cornice and centre rose and arch to inner hallway with ceiling cornice and guest w.c off. There are two elegantly appointed interconnecting reception rooms separated with folding doors and featuring 13ft heigh ceilings, matching original Adams marble fireplaces, intricate ceiling cornice and centre rose. 

Beyond the hallway and hidden behind a pocket sliding door is a most impressive contemporary extension featuring a double height ceiling with upper glazing, splayed skylights and floor to ceiling sliding doors to rear garden creating a dramatic architectural statement that floods the interior with an abundance of natural light. The glass staircase leads to the lower level and open plan living/dining/kitchen area, the kitchen itself has a range of Siematic modern gloss handless units with large island unit housing the undermount sink and further storage all finished with a 6 inch deep wolfstone granite worktop throughout. There is a lobby off with a well-equipped utility room and fully tiled shower room. 

There is a self contained one bedroom apartment at ground floor level with separate entrance and comprising of entrance lobby with storage, open plan kitchen/dining/living with ample storage and double bedroom with ensuite. Discreetly behind a fitted bookcase provides access to the main house via the lobby at ground floor level. This is ideally suited as a granny flat, investment income or accommodation for au pair.  

Upstairs, on the first floor return is the first bedroom, currently in use study / dressing room with ample wardrobes and solid wood desk and shelving. On the first floor are a further two bedrooms – the principle bedroom is positioned to the front of the house and overlooking the Square with fitted wardrobes, ceiling cornice, marble mantlepiece, window shutters and luxurious ensuite shower room with extra deep bath, separate shower, w.c, whb and recessed mirrored medicine cabinet with shelving. The final bedroom is to the rear of the property with fitted wardrobes, ceiling cornice and marble fireplace. The spa like shower room completes the internal accommodation of this impressive property– fully tiled with high ceilings, walk in shower, w.c, whb and recessed shelving. 

Outside are landscaped gardens to the front and rear. To the front is granite paving with access to first and ground floor level. To the rear is a magnificent south facing garden which is not overlooked. Approximately 28 meters long with paved two paved patio areas ensuring you can dine alfresco throughout the entire day, lawn flanked by Espalier Beech trees and a magnificent row of Tuscan Cypress trees providing immense privacy from all sides.
An enviable location with all the area has to offer, Kenilworth Square is ideally positioned within a short walk to the villages of Rathgar and Rathmines with their fantastic choice of restaurants, bars and shops as well as shops on Rathmines Road Upper. There are of top primary and secondary schools in the area including Rathgar Junior, Alexandra College, Gonzaga, St. Mary’s, Kildare Place and Rathgar National to name a few. Recreational facilities are also well catered for in the area with numerous gyms, sports clubs, yoga studios and saunas all within walking distance. For public transport there are a host of buses in Harold’s Cross, Kenilworth Road and Rathgar Road all providing quick and easy access into the city centre, Dublin airport and further afield.
